description: This Java class implements a factory for creating different types of loan schedule generators based on the loan schedule type and interest method. It uses switch statements to select the appropriate generator instance.

classes.name: DefaultLoanScheduleGeneratorFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates LoanScheduleGenerator instances based on loan schedule type and interest method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a LoanScheduleGenerator based on the provided LoanScheduleType and InterestMethod.

methods.name: cumulativeLoanScheduleGenerator
methods.description: Returns a loan schedule generator for cumulative interest types based on InterestMethod.

methods.name: progressiveLoanScheduleGenerator
methods.description: Returns a loan schedule generator for progressive interest types based on InterestMethod.
